blocks.en: Procedure for Changing the Grading Method of General Education (공통교육과정) Courses
<20 Aug 2026 (Thu), Education Team, 학부대학 (College of Liberal Studies)>
1. Go to the SNU portal mySNU (http://my.snu.ac.kr) and log in
blocks.ko: 1. 서울대학교 포털 mySNU(http://my.snu.ac.kr) 접속 후 로그인

blocks.en: 2. Go to the menu: 학사정보 (Academic Information) → 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) → 수업 (Classes) → 성적평가방법변경신청 (Grading Method Change Request)
blocks.ko: 2. 메뉴 이동 : 학사정보 → 수업/성적 → 수업 → 성적평가방법변경신청

blocks.en: 3. How to request a change of grading method
① In the '성적평가방법변경신청' (Grading Method Change Request) menu, select the semester and click the '검색' (Search) button
blocks.ko: ① ‘성적평가방법변경신청’ 메뉴에서 학기 선택 후 ‘검색’ 버튼 클릭

blocks.en: - Only the registered courses whose grading method can be changed will be shown
blocks.ko: - 수강신청한 과목중 성적평가방법 변경신청이 가능한 수강 과목만 조회됨

blocks.en: <Screen of the Grading Method Change Request menu>
② For the course you want to change, change and select the '변경후' (After Change) item under '성적부여방법' (Grading Method), then click the '저장' (Save) button
blocks.ko: ② 변경을 원하는 과목의 ‘성적부여방법’의 ‘변경후’ 항목을 변경하여 선택한 후, ‘저장’버튼 클릭

blocks.en: - You can choose either '등급성적(A~F)' (letter grade, A–F) or '급락성적(S/U)' (pass/fail grade, S/U)
- After saving, make sure that the grade type you selected is shown under '변경후' (After Change)
blocks.ko: - 저장 후 ‘변경후’성적에 선택한 성적이 표시되는지 반드시 확인

blocks.en: - During the grading method change period, you can change and save it as many times as you want
blocks.ko: - 성적평가방법 변경기간 동안에는 여러 번 수정하여 저장 가능

blocks.en: <Screen after saving the Grading Method Change Request>

※ A grading method change request can be made only during the period set for each semester (for regular semesters: from the first day of classes until the point when 1/4 of the class days have passed)
blocks.ko: ※ 성적평가방법 변경신청은 학기별로 정해진 기간(정규학기 기준 개강일 ~ 수업일수 1/4선)

blocks.en: and it can never be changed after this period ends
blocks.ko: 에만 할 수 있으며, 기간이 종료된 이후에는 절대 변경불가능함

english: This notice explains the period and the procedure for changing the grading method (for example, between letter grades and Pass/Fail) for courses in the 공통교육과정 (Common Curriculum) that are offered in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year and allow such a change.
Attachment 1. List of courses whose grading method can be changed in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year
Attachment 2. Manual for changing the grading method of 공통교육과정 (Common Curriculum) courses
